run_rationale: This run reveals no actionable edge across all candidates due to critically low trade counts (n ranging from 4 to 17), far below the T2 floor of n≥100, rendering backtest results unreliable despite some high PF and Sharpe values. The simplified-signal caveat further erodes trust in the current outputs, as faithful signal translation is pending for v3. A retry is warranted with a longer historical dataset to increase trade counts and after the faithful-signal translator is implemented to ensure accurate spec interpretation.
